source: Trane Technologies press release: Trane Technologies to Acquire Cancoil, Strengthening Supply (10-21-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Trane Technologies entered a definitive agreement to acquire Cancoil Thermal Corporation, an Ontario, Canada-headquartered maker of heat-transfer products (fluid coolers, air-cooled condensers, custom finned-tube coils) used in data centers and other commercial and industrial applications, with manufacturing in Ontario and in Jacksonville, Texas and more than 450 employees; Cancoil, Cancoil USA and Fin Aire Inc. join Trane. Cancoil is a current supplier to Trane's chiller and airside businesses; COO Donny Simmons said it adds heat-transfer expertise and supply chain resiliency. Completion is expected before the end of the year, subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approval.
